描述_ZN: The Dragon Boat Race" scroll, Ming, painted by Zheng Chong, on silk with color, 129.5 cm in length and 58 cm in width.　　Signed on this scroll: "Thousand Miles Zheng Chong". Inscriptions of the collection seal of the Qing government include: "Sanxitang Jingjian Seal", "Yizi Sun", "Jiaqing Imperial Treasures", "Shiqu Baoji ", "Baoji three editions", "the treasure of the Xuantong imperial tour".　　The scene depicted in this picture is exactly the scene of the lake area in the southern region of China during the Dragon Boat Festival. The picture adopts Ma Yuan's "one-corner" composition, with the young and old watching the dragon boat race concentrated on the shore in the lower right corner of the picture, hidden between the lake and the trees and rocks, and with people riding on the branches of the tree trunks to get a better viewing angle of the race. A large amount of white space is left in the picture to form a lake with four dragon boats and one phoenix boat on the lake, which are competing with each other. The distant mountains appear in the background. The whole picture is exquisite and lively, a masterpiece of custom painting.　　This painting inherits the gorgeous blue and green landscape painting style of "General Li" of the Tang Dynasty, with a vivid overall atmosphere, detailed color outline, and drawing on the characteristics of the times in the composition and details of brushwork. style.
